card.title: IPhone XR SIM Card is not being detected

source.title: IPhone XR SIM Card is not being detected

claims.statement: On iPhone XR/11/12 the SIM reader is modular; replace it first when 'No SIM' shows but IMEI and modem firmware are present.
Chinese dual physical SIM readers can be swapped between these models.

procedure: Confirm IMEI and modem firmware present.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
